minimal_certificate: For rank80 rules, kernel is all-ones bit vector. The 81-bit output has even parity; omit its redundant most-significant output bit and append the original input's bit0. This 81-bit augmented map is invertible and gives exact recovery. Rank81 rules use full inverse with zero extra input bits.
why_one_bit_necessary: Rank80 mapping has a two-element kernel. Without at least one extra bit, both members of each preimage pair map to an identical future state, so no deterministic inverse exists.
independent_implementations: Python 81-column GF2 matrix and Node GF2 cyclic polynomial, each with separately authored Gauss-Jordan inverse
python_node_execution_location: Single local ChatGPT compute environment; not physical-host separation.
